54	  "visual_prompt": "Square 1:1 photorealistic before/after split-screen supplement ad, recreating this exact layout. TOP HEADER BAND (top 12.5% of the canvas), split into two equal halves: the left half is a solid dark plum (#2B1226) block with the huge white heavy rounded uppercase word 'ANTES' centered and, under it, a centered two-line bold white subtitle; the right half is a solid hot fuchsia (#E6177F) block with the huge white word 'DESPUÉS' centered and its centered two-line bold white subtitle. A thin white vertical line divides the canvas in two from the top band down to the benefit panel. PHOTO AREA (12.5% to 68% of the height), two equal photos side by side: LEFT 'before' photo — an adult woman about 27 years old with long wavy dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, medium shot from the waist up in a three-quarter back view, looking over her shoulder with a doubtful, tired expression, standing in a bright neutral bedroom with a white-sheeted bed and a wooden headboard, wearing a loose white crew-neck t-shirt and gray cotton jogger pants, flat cool daylight, slightly muted colors. RIGHT 'after' photo — the same woman, same hair and same three-quarter back framing from the waist up, looking over her shoulder with a big confident smile, standing on a Caribbean beach at golden-hour sunset with turquoise sea and palm silhouettes, wearing a hot-pink long-sleeve athletic top and matching hot-pink full-length leggings that fully cover her, warm glowing backlight, relaxed happy posture, she looks energetic and pleased with her progress. A wholesome lifestyle mood, no focus on body parts. HERO PRODUCT: the attached product bottle, large, front-facing and perfectly sharp, standing centered exactly on the vertical dividing line, from about 20% to 68% of the canvas height, overlapping both photos, its base resting on the top edge of the benefit panel, soft studio light and a soft shadow. Product: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh underline, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace, relabel or reinterpret it, and do not add any badge to it. REGISTRATION SEAL: a round white seal with a thin metallic fuchsia rim overlapping the lower-right side of the bottle (about 10% of the canvas width), with 'REGISTRO SANITARIO' curved along the top arc, 'INVIMA' in bold deep magenta in the center and 'RSA-0030271-2024' curved along the bottom arc. Card 3: icon of three ascending bars. Card 4: icon of a shield with a check mark. OFFER BAR (88% to 98% of the height): one wide, fully rounded pill bar across nearly the full width, deep magenta-to-wine gradient fill with a thin glowing fuchsia border; on its left part two stacked lines of text, the second line larger, flanked by three short bubblegum-pink burst lines on each side; a thin white vertical divider; on its right part a glossy pale blush pink (#FBE3EE) inner pill holding the price in huge heavy deep magenta (#B0105E) numerals. Typography for all text: heavy rounded geometric sans-serif (Nunito Black / Gotham Rounded Bold look), crisp and perfectly legible on a phone. Write every text exactly as listed in the text layers, each once, in its position. 70	    { "block_id": "text_block_15", "reference_function": "price", "reference_position": "Offer bar, right part, inside the pale pink pill", "text_style": "Heaviest rounded sans-serif, huge, deep magenta", "text": "$139.900" }

72	  "mandatory_visual_elements": [
73	    "Two-color header band: dark plum left, hot fuchsia right",
74	    "Thin white vertical divider between the two halves",
75	    "Before photo: woman in a waist-up three-quarter back view in a bedroom, loose white t-shirt and gray joggers, doubtful expression",
76	    "After photo: same woman, same waist-up framing, on a sunset beach in a hot-pink long-sleeve athletic top and leggings, smiling confidently",
77	    "The user's black bottle with fuchsia cap and fuchsia bottom band, large, centered on the divider",
78	    "Round white registration seal with fuchsia rim overlapping the lower-right of the bottle",
79	    "Four rounded benefit cards with glowing fuchsia outlines and white thin-line icons (measuring tape with circular arrow, hand with package, ascending bars, shield with check)",
80	    "Wide rounded offer bar with burst lines, a thin vertical divider and a pale pink price pill"
81	  ],

89	    "Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.",
90	    "Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements."

92	  "meta_policy_check": "All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts. The four benefit labels and the offer are kept exactly as the user provided them for their winning ad.",
93	  "language_rule": "All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish."
